transcript: Speaker A (Vendor): Fresh vegetables! Buy fresh vegetables! Potatoes, onion, tomato! Very fresh and very cheap vegetables. Come fast and take healthy green vegetables! Speaker B (Customer): Are these onions fresh today? Speaker A (Vendor): Yes, very fresh. And the potatoes are also good quality. Speaker B (Customer): अरे! तुम तो इतनी अच्छी इंग्लिश बोलके सब्जी बेच रहे हो? वाह! कहाँ से सीखा इतनी अच्छी इंग्लिश बोलना? [Oh! You are selling vegetables while speaking such good English? Wow! Where did you learn to speak such good English?] Speaker A (Vendor): इंग्लिश सीखो से मैम, इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप से। [From English Seekho, ma'am, from the English Seekho app.] Speaker B (Customer): इंग्लिश सीखो? ये क्या है? [English Seekho? What is this?] Speaker A (Vendor): इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप, स्पोकन इंग्लिश का बेस्ट ऐप है। जिसमें एकदम बेसिक लेवल से इंग्लिश बोलना सिखाया जाता है। और इसी वजह से मेरे जैसा एक अनपढ़ आदमी भी फर्राटेदार इंग्लिश बोलना सीख सकता है। इसमें वर्ड टू वर्ड जोड़कर सेंटेंस बनाने से लेकर उसे फ्लूएंट इंग्लिश में कैसे बोलना है, सब कुछ छोटे-छोटे वीडियोस के थ्रू सिखाया जाता है। [English Seekho app is the best app for spoken English. In which English speaking is taught from the very basic level. And because of this, even an uneducated man like me can learn to speak fluent English. In this, from making sentences by joining word to word to how to speak it in fluent English, everything is taught through short videos.] Speaker B (Customer): अरे वाह! मैं भी डाउनलोड करती हूँ इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप। And please give me one kilo onions, brother. [Oh wow! I will also download the English Seekho app. And please give me one kilo onions, brother.] Speaker A (Vendor): अरे मैम, आप तो इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप का नाम सुनकर ही इंग्लिश बोलने लगीं! वाह! [Oh ma'am, you started speaking English just by hearing the name of the English Seekho app! Wow!] Speaker C (Voiceover): तो इंस्टॉल बटन पर क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho. INSTALL NOW. [Disclaimer text explaining that the app is not affiliated with any government authority and results may vary based on individual effort.]
summary: A customer is amazed when a local vegetable vendor speaks fluent English to sell his produce. He explains that he learned it easily through the English Seekho app, which teaches spoken English from basic levels using short videos. The ad ends with a call to action to install the app.
